fusions.name: Quarry Chosen
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 26 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds and [Marked] for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Throws a knife up to 8 tiles at a target at or below 25% health, dealing 22 damage, up to 1.3 times harder at maximum range.

fusions.name: Scent of the Kill
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Onto the Next
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 15 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
